personalInformation.title: ETRM Functional Consultant — Energy Trading & Risk Management
personalInformation.tagline: Working at the intersection of energy markets, trading operations, ETRM platforms and data.

summary: ETRM Functional Consultant with hands-on experience across the full energy trading lifecycle — from Front Office trade capture and market submissions through Middle Office valuation and risk, to Back Office settlements, reconciliation and reporting.
philosophy: An ETRM consultant should not only know how to configure a screen or execute a test case. They should understand why the trade is being done, how it's priced, how it affects position and risk, how it generates P&L, how it's settled, and how it's finally reported. That end-to-end understanding is what allows an ETRM consultant to solve problems effectively.

responsibilities: Front Office Support: Primary functional lead for FO teams, managing daily trade execution, EOD validation, and price integration within Aligne ETRM.
Market Submissions: Utilised Hitachi nMarket Bid Manager to create, review, and edit energy bids/offers aligned with market conditions and regulatory requirements.
Settlements & Valuation: Led trade estimation and settlement calculations, utilising FMT Tool for automated price and FX data importing.
Dispute & Reconciliation: Validated data consistency by cross-checking daily JRA records, supporting back-office dispute management and root cause investigation.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinated with Capacity Team for generation audits; aligned back-office systems with Aligne data for P&L and cashflow reporting.
Release & BAU Ownership: Managed daily BAU operations, owned end-to-end Sanity, UAT, and Functional testing cycles. Performed API, data, and integration testing using SoapUI and SQL.
Built foundation in ETRM consulting — requirements gathering, trade lifecycle, and Front / Middle / Back Office processes using Enuit Entrade.
Requirement gathering, project scoping, and planning for client engagements across energy markets.
Identified and resolved software bugs collaboratively; performed database upgrades between system versions.
Debugged code and delivered solutions for client-raised issues in settlements, accounting, and data processes.
Worked across front office, mid office, and back office for settlements and accounting processes.
Participated in Sanity, UAT, SIT, and Functional testing; managed physical/financial positions and electronic trade execution.

education.institution: Sahyog College of Management Studies, Mumbai
